text.tspan: The kernel records who owns each resource and checks it on every use. It never decides what a LibOS does with what it owns.

g.text: Five kinds of resource, one rule
Revocation: the kernel may ask for a resource back · src/revoke.c
Policy today is deliberately trivial: nothing asks on the boot path. exo_exit frees a context's resources directly; exo_launch and exo_launch_pkg call revoke_all() on the previous instance of an app.
